goals: Provide a portable, local-first AI project orchestration framework compatible with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, and Antigravity.
Enforce deterministic lifecycle state transitions (G0 through G6) with verified evidence gates.
Eliminate AI context degradation, hallucinated progress, and uncontrolled scope expansion through durable git-aware memory.

architecturalDecisions.title: Local-First, Schema-Driven, Contract-Centric Architecture
architecturalDecisions.choice: All project contracts, state, and decisions reside in git-tracked JSON and Markdown files without external DB dependencies.
architecturalDecisions.consequences: Requires strict JSON Schema Draft-07 validation and git-aware reconciliation; guarantees complete portability and auditability.

architecturalDecisions.title: Deterministic Lifecycle Gate Progression (G0-G6)
architecturalDecisions.choice: Strict finite state machine where progression requires evidence-backed approval contracts. Exemptions must be explicitly recorded.
architecturalDecisions.consequences: Prevents premature coding before requirements (G1) and architecture (G3) are locked; ensures verifiable quality gates.

architecturalDecisions.title: Three-Tier Git-Aware Memory and Non-Destructive Reconciliation
architecturalDecisions.choice: Partition project memory into Durable Knowledge, Execution State, and Backlog & History, reconciled via git status and log.
architecturalDecisions.consequences: Detects branch switches, rebases, and dirty working trees without overwriting uncommitted human developer edits.

codingConventions: Python 3.10+ standard library implementation with strict type annotations; zero unapproved external pip dependencies for core engine.
All contract and memory payloads must strictly validate against core/schemas/ specifications.
Never commit, log, or persist private keys, API tokens, passwords, or credentials into repository files or memory state.
Preserve all existing human developer code conventions, formatting styles, and uncommitted edits during reconciliation.

domainVocabulary.Gate: A deterministic lifecycle checkpoint (G0 to G6) governing project progression from discovery to release.
domainVocabulary.Contract: A schema-validated canonical JSON agreement defining requirements, architecture, or deliverables for a gate.
domainVocabulary.Envelope: The standardized canonical JSON wrapper containing contract metadata, status, approvals, and traceability.
domainVocabulary.Reconciliation: The deterministic synchronization process aligning execution memory with git commits and working-tree state.
